homeLine: Every day with you starts a little more magical
homeNote: You're my home, a place where I can always come to.

homeNote.label: Your weekly reminder, Precious
homeNote.note: This is your weekly reminder of how much I love you.

homeNote: Thank you for being the Swarnima you are.
I wish to be so close to you that even our atoms get confused about who they belong to.
usNote: I leave a little space for you, wherever I am.
When I check my phone, I expect you to be there.
One day the distance will be zero. Until then, there's this.
In every life, I'd find you.
searchNote: If a song makes you think of me, play it twice.
Look for the one that sounds like us.
Whatever you find, I hope it makes you smile.
libraryNote: Every folder here is a mood, and all of them are you.
Some of these I found because of you. Some, for you.
I'd make a folder for every day I've loved you.
playingNote: Whatever's playing, I'm thinking of you.
Close your eyes for this one, baby.
This one's better with you next to me.
If you're listening, you're thinking of me too.
